title: The Ring of Mushrooms
text: A perfect ring of white mushrooms, pale as knucklebones, grows in a clearing, while sweet, thin music plays from nowhere. Step in, the stories say, and you dance for a night or a hundred years. In the middle of the ring lies a single shoe.

options.label: The boldest steps into the ring to dance.

outcomes.text: They dance for a night and come out laughing, younger in the eyes.
They dance for longer than a night, then sleep where they fall.

options.label: The Leader picks the white mushrooms, music or no music.

outcomes.text: The music stops all at once. The mushrooms are worth a great deal to the right apothecary.

options.label: Walk well round the ring, without listening too closely.

outcomes.text: The music follows you a while, and your feet keep wanting to dance. You are quicker on them for it.

options.label: The Gambler bets they can step in and out before the music notices.

outcomes.text: They are in and out with a fistful of fair-folk coin and a grin.
The music notices. They come out next morning, still dancing, a year older in the face.
